.table-art{background-image:var(--living-art);background-size:cover;background-position:center;filter:brightness(.86)}
.table{background:var(--board-art) center/100% 100%;border:0;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #815839,0 7px 0 #694329,0 12px 0 #54351f,0 17px 0 #392618,0 26px 28px #1a100c80,0 44px 65px #130d0966;transform:rotateX(9deg)!important;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.table-shell{width:min(78svh,84vw,920px);top:53%;perspective:1600px}
.deck{width:20%;filter:drop-shadow(0 9px 6px #160c0a88)}
.deck.roots{left:50%;top:19%;--tilt:180deg}
.deck.field{left:20.5%;top:40.4%;--tilt:108deg}
.deck.garden{left:79.5%;top:40.4%;--tilt:252deg}
.deck.vine{left:31.8%;top:75%;--tilt:36deg}
.deck.seasons{left:68.2%;top:75%;--tilt:324deg}
.title{color:#fff2d6;text-shadow:0 2px 8px #23170f}.cute{color:#e4c799;text-shadow:0 2px 5px #23170f}.result-pill{top:94px}
@media(max-width:620px){.table-shell{width:min(91vw,71svh);top:52%}.result-pill{top:106px}}
@media(max-height:550px) and (orientation:landscape){.table-shell{width:76svh;top:53%}.result-pill{top:40%}}
